topic.source_contract: section 106 legal interests, statutory tests, deed execution, triggers, indexation, monitoring and delivered mitigation

scope_guards: A draft heads of terms is not treated as an executed planning obligation.
A committee resolution is not treated as a completed deed or granted permission.
A signed deed is not treated as triggered, paid or delivered mitigation.
A financial contribution is not treated as infrastructure delivery without receipt, spend and completion evidence.
A unilateral undertaking is not treated as binding the local planning authority as a covenanting party.
A viability appraisal is not treated as an agreed reduction in obligations.
A monitoring entry is not treated as discharge of every covenant.
No score or promotion is written without exact land interests, executed deed, permission, triggers, compliance and delivery evidence.
row_checks: Exact application and decision route required
Current title and legal interests required
Necessary, directly related, scale and kind tested
Bilateral agreement or unilateral undertaking separated
Lender consent or priority position required
Commencement, occupation and phase triggers required
Base date and index formula required
Tenure, units, transfer and nominations required
Purpose, recipient and spend deadline required
S106 and highway agreement roles separated
Deed of variation or statutory modification required
Completed facility or service evidence required
Current permission, triggers and delivery unresolved
